annotations.ce_understood_harm: Talking would hand the other person five years behind bars
annotations.pda_responsibility: I walked into that warehouse by choice
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I don't trade someone else's freedom for mine
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I'd bend that if the other person had hurt somebody

annotations.ce_understood_harm: my testimony could put my partner away for five years
annotations.pda_responsibility: that's on me, not on the police
annotations.sys_rule_justification: cooperate with an investigation, full stop
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If my evidence had to be stretched or exaggerated to count, I'd refuse

annotations.ce_understood_harm: talking could cost the other person five
annotations.pda_responsibility: I helped create this by joining the break-in
annotations.sys_rule_justification: My default is loyalty to the people I act with
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if someone was, loyalty stops being the priority

annotations.ce_understood_harm: lock the other guy up for five years while I walk
annotations.pda_responsibility: I got myself into that room by breaking into the warehouse
annotations.sys_rule_justification: Keeping quiet is my rule here
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if staying silent meant someone innocent got blamed, I'd speak

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Naming them could cost that person five years inside
annotations.pda_responsibility: My own part, I own completely; I chose to go in
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I normally treat testimony against a partner as off-limits
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the partner had used violence, I'd change that

annotations.ce_understood_harm: five years for my partner, time that can't be given back
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd have to live knowing my statement did that
annotations.pda_responsibility: I can't pretend I'm a bystander; I took part
annotations.sys_rule_justification: My general rule is to answer honestly when the law asks
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: guessing could jail someone for the wrong thing

annotations.ce_understood_harm: the person in the next room could get five years
annotations.pda_responsibility: Nobody pushed me through that warehouse door
annotations.sys_rule_justification: My rule is to carry my own consequences
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I'd been dragged into this under threat, I'd reconsider

annotations.ce_understood_harm: the other person could serve five years
annotations.pda_responsibility: my words are a big piece of that
annotations.sys_rule_justification: tell the whole truth no matter what
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I knew that person had dependents... I might hold back

annotations.ce_understood_harm: that partner does five years and I stroll out
annotations.pda_responsibility: the mess started with my choice
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I keep a rule of never informing on someone
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I'd drop it if silence let danger continue

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Talking could hand the other person five years
annotations.pda_responsibility: I put myself in this spot by joining the break-in
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: unless I learned the break-in harmed someone directly
annotations.sys_rule_justification: an injured person's claim outweighs protecting either of us
